[Council File 26-1072]
Motion (McOsker - Yaroslavsky) relative to Measure United to House Los Angeles property transfer tax exemptions for non-profit entities created specifically for property acquisitions.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: The city would provide property transfer tax breaks to non-profit organizations that acquire housing for low-income residents.
